# Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Jonathan Long, Evan Shelhamer, Trevor Darrell  
**Year:** 2015  
**Journal:** CVPR  
**DOI:** [10.1109/CVPR.2015.7298965](https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2015.7298965)  
**Publisher:** [https://www.cv-foundation.org/openaccess/content_cvpr_2015/papers/Long_Fully_Convolutional_Networks_2015_paper.pdf](https://www.cv-foundation.org/openaccess/content_cvpr_2015/papers/Long_Fully_Convolutional_Networks_2015_paper.pdf)

**Keywords:** fcn, semantic segmentation

## Abstract

We adapt contemporary classification networks into fully convolutional networks and transfer their learned representations to the segmentation task.
